name: Hjalmar Wijk
bio: Hjalmar Wijk is a member of METR, listed on the organization's evaluations site as Chief Scientist; a later source lists the role as technical staff. Wijk is an author of METR's 2025 paper on measuring AI ability to complete long tasks and of the HCAST benchmark.
known_for: AI agent capability evaluation at METR
Co-author of 'Measuring AI Ability to Complete Long Tasks'
